note: Rows for the DPS axis of the gold-per-damage chart. Gold and damage per step; damage is percent of ONE character's own damage — no party multiplier belongs on this axis. Scored with loa-bracelet-calc/model/bracelet.js on the reference character: ilvl 1785 T4 Upper, level-9 gems, high/high accessories, 9-7 stone, Adrenaline 7, karma 21, ark grid 60/60/60 side nodes with the Ancient ATTACK core at 20 points, 90% crit / 280% crit damage. Accessory rows are not baked: the page builds them live from accessory-scores.json / accessory-configs.json (support) and accessory-configs-dps.json (DPS) for the flat-line and main-stat families the switches tick.
